name: Bad Influences
overview: Scripture warns believers about the dangers of associating with those who lead them away from wisdom and godly character. Proverbs teaches that walking with the wise leads to wisdom, but companionship with fools results in destruction. Likewise, it cautions against forming friendships with angry or furious individuals, as their influence can provoke harm. In Matthew, Jesus reminds His followers that they are the salt of the earth, called to preserve and influence the world positively; losing this distinctiveness renders them ineffective and discarded.
